context: A mom unpacks her young son's day with him
purpose: Teach: ただただ/なんらかの/あがり/かえる/愉快/平凡/悪口/手足

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おかえり、翔。今日は学校どうだった？平凡な一日だった？
lines.en: Welcome home, Sho. How was school today? Just an ordinary day?
lines.style: Warm motherly greeting with gentle curiosity, soft falling tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ううん、今日はね、すっごく愉快な日だったよ！体育で走ったら息があがりすぎちゃった。
lines.en: Nope, today was a super fun day! I got so out of breath running in PE.
lines.style: Excited child voice, breathless energy, slightly proud delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらあら、それは大変。どこか痛くない？手足も大丈夫？転んだりしなかった？
lines.en: Oh my, that sounds rough. Anywhere hurt? Arms and legs okay? Didn't fall?
lines.style: Concerned but lightly teasing maternal tone, soft inflection with checking pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: へいき！でもね、ケンタくんがまた先生の悪口言ってて、ぼくびっくりしちゃった。
lines.en: I'm fine! But Kenta was talking trash about the teacher again, I was shocked.
lines.style: Childlike tattling tone, eyes wide with mild scandal.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そう…そういう時はね、なんらかの形でちゃんと先生に伝えたほうがいいかもね。
lines.en: I see... in cases like that, you should properly tell the teacher in some way.
lines.style: Thoughtful motherly advice, gentle and measured pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。あとね、帰り道で猫見つけて、ぼくのこと見てただただ鳴いてたの。
lines.en: Yeah. Also on the way home, a cat just kept meowing at me nonstop.
lines.style: Wistful child narrating, drifting into a softer storytelling voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、可愛いね。今度その子の様子をかえる前に、写真撮れたら見せてね。
lines.en: Hehe, cute. Next time, before that kitty's mood changes, snap a photo for me.
lines.style: Soft laughing maternal warmth, playful encouraging tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん！じゃあ手足あらってくる！おなかぺこぺこ！
lines.en: Okay! I'll go wash my hands and feet! I'm starving!
lines.style: Bouncy childlike enthusiasm, quick energetic delivery with rising tone.
